canonical_project: Kepstar Data Center DC2 (resilience site ~100 km from Phnom Penh)
notes: Kepstar's second planned carrier-neutral facility: 50,000 sq ft with 3.5 MW critical IT load, reported as a resilience/disaster-recovery site ~100 km from Phnom Penh (per Network World 2022 and World Teleport/Singtel advising report; combined 10 MW and 1,600 racks across DC1+DC2). Exact province of the 100 km-away site is not confirmed in public sources; Baxtel lists Kepstar DC2 as planned. Line is filed under Phnom Penh division per Baxtel's Phnom Penh market listing, with location uncertainty noted.
